_doc: The bots' spending brain (Update 03 section 6; gravelight/bots/bot_economy.gd, pure rules tested in test_bot_brain.gd). Each bot spends its own Scrip by priority: perks in perk_plan order ('@weapon' = trigger_tonic or twin_barrel by the class of its main gun: weapon_perk), Second Wind only in co-op (second_wind_coop_only; there is no solo self-revive for a bot); a wall gun good for the round (weapon_tiers vs want_tier_by_round, never past weapon_max_round: no Kar98k after round 10); an ammo box when the main gun's reserve is under ammo_box_below (wall ammo when its own wall-buy is in range and the reserve is under wall_ammo_below); doors only when ordered, when the human opened a door already and stands by this one (near_human_m), or when no human leads (bot_led); the Requisition Crate above crate.min_scrip with a main gun weak for the round; the Crucible for a gun of crucible.min_tier or better. reserve: it always keeps enough for one revive-critical perk rebuy (reserve.perk's price) plus an ammo box, x the personality's save_bias. priorities are the 0..1 'buy_task' values the utility AI sees. Never: easter-egg objects, traps, the power switch (unless ordered or the human already did that step), a teammate's crate roll or Crucible weapon.
_weapon_perk_doc: T-058: a magazine-bound automatic (a Thompson empties its 30 in 2.6 s and reloads for 3) gains most from Trigger Tonic's half reload; a semi rifle or bolt gun from Twin Barrel's rate.

perk_upgrades._doc: T-075: perk tiers (BotEconomy.upgrade_wanted). Only when the perk plan has nothing left to buy (cap full or everything drunk), from min_round (tier III from tier3_min_round), in this plan's order ('@weapon' as in perk_plan), keeping reserve + extra_reserve; an unaffordable first choice is saved for. T-121: the rounds match the machines' own gates (perks.json upgrades.min_round: II from 8, III from 15), and a squad bot has no mastery lock (it has no profile; PerkManager.can_upgrade). The bot-mode agent plays the human's survivor and keeps the human's lock.

crucible._doc: T-121: a bot feeds its best gun (BotBrain.best_to_teach: a taught gun counts its teachings, so it is fed again before a fresh one), from min_round, a gun of min_tier or better. save_for_reteach: once its best gun is taught and can learn more, the crate and the wall guns leave the next teaching's price (7500 / 10000) on top of the reserve, so it reaches the second and third teaching instead of rolling the crate.

power._doc: T-058: with no human in the match or leading (BotSquad.bot_led), the squad is its own leader: from min_round it buys the closed door on the way to the power switch (keeping only door_reserve_scrip back) and throws the switch; until then every other door must leave the power door's price in hand. self_led_useful_doors_only: a self-led squad opens only the power's door and the doors an authored training route needs (routes_<map>.json requires_doors). With a human, the old rule stands: the power only when ordered (perks follow once the human threw it).
power._plan_avoid_doc: T-107: zones the power route never plans through (bots cannot ride the Kaltenbrunn lift); the stairs route is the one they can walk. T-115: and Mondlicht's yard (no air; the bots cross it only on a training loop between the posts).

_self_led_mid_round_doc: T-058: a squad with no human leading it shops beyond this distance from its home loop (or its leader) only between waves.
